title: Merge maintenance windows
description:
Several teams have each scheduled maintenance windows on the same system. The customer wants one clean list of when the system is actually down.

Write `merge_windows(windows)` where each window is `[start, end]` with `start <= end`. Merge every set of windows that overlap or touch (one ends exactly when another starts) and return the merged windows sorted by start.

**Example**

```
merge_windows([[8, 10], [1, 3], [2, 6], [10, 12]])
# [[1, 6], [8, 12]]
```
hints: Sort the windows by start time first. After that, a window can only overlap the most recent merged one.
If the next window starts at or before the end of the last merged window, extend that end. Otherwise start a new merged window.
Use `max` when extending: the next window might end earlier than the one it overlaps.
